node A "Device A" ref="packages/core/mesh/network-manager/src/signal/swarm-messenger.ts"
node Edge "EDGE" ref="packages/core/mesh/edge-client/src/edge-client.ts"
node B "Device B" ref="packages/core/mesh/network-manager/src/signal/swarm-messenger.ts"
edge A -> Edge "join topic"
edge B -> Edge "join topic"
edge Edge -> A "peer B joined"
edge Edge -> B "peer A joined"
edge A -> Edge "offer"
edge Edge -> B "offer"
edge B -> Edge "answer"
edge Edge -> A "answer"
fragment loop "until connected" {
  edge A sends Edge "ICE candidates"
  edge Edge sends B "ICE candidates"
}
edge A -> B "direct WebRTC link"
